notes: This board covers a collection of spring-themed books rather than a single title. Vocabulary has been selected to span common spring book themes: life cycles (egg, butterfly, worm, bird), weather (rain, sun, puddle, muddy), and gardening/nature (flower, garden, grow). Several words already exist in activity_images/ (worm, puddle, muddy, garden, grow, sun) and should be reused. The hero slot uses a generic spring chick or flower image — consider using the existing 'garden' or 'sun' icon from activity_images/ if a dedicated spring character image is unavailable. If specific books in this collection have named characters, a dedicated board per book would be more appropriate.
